title: Senior Claims & Litigation Paralegal - Transportation
description:
Charger Logistics Inc . is a world-class asset-based carrier with locations across North America. With over 20 years of experience providing the best logistics solutions, Charger Logistics has transformed into a world-class transport provider and continues to grow.
Charger Logistics is seeking an experienced Senior Claims & Litigation Paralegal - Transportation to join our in-house Legal Department. This person will work closely with in-house counsel and outside litigation counsel in managing a significant portfolio of U.S. transportation-related litigation and claims.
Key Responsibilities:

• Manage and support commercial-auto bodily injury, catastrophic-loss, property-damage and transportation litigation/claims.

• Coordinate immediate evidence preservation following significant accidents, including driver qualification/personnel records, ELD/HOS, telematics/GPS, ECM data, dashcam/video, maintenance/inspection records, dispatch communications, bills of lading, photographs, police reports and witness information.

• Review accident reports, demand packages, medical records and claim documentation and prepare litigation chronologies.

• Under attorney supervision, prepare first drafts of answers, responses, affidavits/declarations, notices, motions and other litigation documents.

• Assist with interrogatories, requests for production/admission, subpoenas, discovery, document collection and legal holds.

• Prepare exhibits, document and medical summaries, deposition/mediation materials and trial binders.

• Maintain complete litigation files and calendars and track pleading, discovery, deposition, mediation, motion and trial deadlines.

• Maintain concise case summaries identifying allegations, damages, exposure, defence strategy, deadlines and next steps.

• Coordinate with outside counsel, monitor case strategy/budgets/deadlines and assist with review of outside counsel invoices and litigation expenses.

• Coordinate with Claims, Safety, Operations, Maintenance, Insurance/Risk Management and other departments.

Requirements

• 5+ years of litigation, claims or senior paralegal experience. Strong preference for trucking/transportation litigation, commercial-auto liability, catastrophic-loss or insurance-defence experience.

• Experience with a motor carrier, insurer, TPA, self-insured transportation company or transportation-defence law firm is highly desirable.

• Candidate should have strong U.S. litigation/discovery knowledge, legal drafting ability, docket/file management skills and familiarity with trucking evidence and FMCSA-related documentation.

Benefits

• Competitive Salary

• Healthcare Benefit Package

• Career Growth

• A stable and structured work environment, ideal for experienced law clerks looking for a balanced, well-organized workload.

• Focus on internal legal matters and file support - no external client development or business-generation pressure.

• The opportunity to apply your expertise across a genuinely varied litigation, enforcement, corporate, and regulatory caseload within a growing North American organization.

title: Organic Social Media & Community Specialist
description:
Organic Social Media & Community Specialist
About Tia

Tia is building a new model for women’s healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, mental health, gynecology, dermatology, and wellness across both in-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike.
About the Role
We’re looking for a creative, data-driven specialist to help the Growth Team expand Tia ’s organic social presence and learn from the communities we serve.
You will own content creation and distribution across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, manage day-to-day community engagement, and build reporting that connects social activity to site traffic. You’ll create content for each platform, then use performance data and audience conversations to shape what we make next.
This is a remote independent contractor role starting at approximately 10 hours per week, with an expected ramp to 15-20 hours per week.
Why Tia

• Help shape how a women’s healthcare company shows up and connects with its community

• Own creative work from concept through publication and performance review

• Build social reporting and community practices with room to make a visible impact

• Work remotely with a team focused on improving care for women across life stages

What You’ll Do

•
Content Strategy: Own and execute the organic social calendar across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, coordinating themes with blog, email, and Growth Team plans.

•
Creative Production: Concept, script, brief, film, and edit short-form video and static content designed for each platform.

•
Platform Distribution: Improve reach and engagement through strong hooks, relevant trends, posting cadence, and TikTok and YouTube search optimization.

•
Reporting & Attribution: Build social reporting in Sprout Social; track referral traffic and link clicks alongside reach, saves, shares, follower growth, watch time, and profile visits. Turn findings into content recommendations.

•
Link Management: Maintain Tia ’s link-in-bio experience, including UTM tagging and landing page priorities.

•
Community Management: Respond to comments and DMs through Meta Business Suite and TikTok using approved guidance. Partner with clinical and operations teams to maintain quick replies and escalate account-specific concerns or formal complaints.

•
Social Listening: Monitor brand mentions, sentiment, competitor content, and audience conversations across social platforms and forums. Share recurring questions, objections, and emerging trends with the Growth Team.

What You’ll Bring
Requirements

• 1+ year of experience managing organic social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

• Examples of content you have created and results you have driven, including audience growth, engagement, or site traffic

• Hands-on experience scripting, filming, editing short-form video, and writing social copy

• Experience with Sprout Social, Meta Business Suite, web analytics such as Google Analytics, and UTM tagging

• Experience moderating communities and using audience feedback or performance data to guide content decisions

• Availability to begin at approximately 10 hours per week and ramp to 15-20 hours per week

Nice to have

• Experience with social communication protocols and escalation paths in healthcare, wellness, fintech, or another regulated industry

• Experience using social listening to identify audience questions and emerging content formats

Work Location
This is a remote role.
Compensation & Benefits
This is an independent contractor engagement. The anticipated commitment begins at approximately 10 hours per week and is expected to increase to 15-20 hours per week.
Contract rate: Ranging from $30 - $40 per hour

title: Software Engineer - Enterprise Engineering

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

THE ROLE

CodeRabbit is building AI-powered developer tools that help engineering teams ship better code faster. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Enterprise Engineering team, you’ll build the systems and features that make our platform reliable, secure, and scalable for large organizations.

You’ll own projects from design through production, working across backend services, enterprise integrations, and self-hosted deployments. This role combines hands-on engineering with customer problem-solving: understanding complex requirements, making thoughtful architectural decisions, and delivering solutions that fit into enterprise development workflows.

- Develop secure systems. Partner with the team to implement security controls and compliance-related capabilities that address enterprise requirements.

- Connect enterprise workflows. Build and maintain integrations with customers’ existing developer tools and internal systems.

- Work closely with customers. Translate customer needs into technical requirements, support successful deployments, and troubleshoot complex production issues.

- Own delivery and quality. Drive projects through design, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing operation, following release practices that protect data integrity and system stability.

- Raise the engineering bar. Contribute thoughtful design and code reviews, mentor other engineers, and improve team practices and tooling.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 4+ years of software engineering experience building and operating backend systems or distributed infrastructure in production, ideally within SaaS or enterprise software.

- Strong proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js, Go, Java, or a comparable modern backend stack.

- Experience designing and maintaining APIs using REST, GraphQL, or similar approaches.

- Experience with AWS or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and production observability.

- Strong engineering fundamentals across testing, code reviews, version control, debugging, and maintainable system design.

- Sound judgment when balancing security, reliability, performance, developer experience, and delivery speed.

- Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with customers and technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Events Intern - Competitive Enterprise Institute
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About Competitive Enterprise Institute:
 
The Competitive Enterprise Institute is a nonprofit think tank based in Washington which focuses on critical economic and regulatory policy issues.
 
CEI’s internship program provides interested students and recent graduates the opportunity to learn about and promote the principles of limited government, free enterprise, and individual liberty. A CEI internship gives applicants the opportunity to work alongside some of the most prominent regulatory affairs scholars and policy specialists.
 
CEI offers a number of internships across the various policy areas we work on, as well as internships in communications and marketing. Generally, CEI’s policy interns are assigned to work with a specific CEI expert for the duration of their internship; and our communications and marketing interns work with the CEI staff of each respective team.
 
CEI’s internship program is an invaluable educational experience. We work with interns to help them grow professionally, hone their skills, and cultivate lasting relationships. Ultimately, our goal is to give interns work that will help them further their careers. Interns are encouraged to be proactive, and exceptional interns are often given the freedom to shape their experience with us and the possibility to explore other opportunities at CEI.
 
Past CEI interns have gone on to work in the executive and legislative branches, federal regulatory agencies, academia, and at prominent research institutions and think tanks. A number of current CEI staff are former CEI interns.
 
You can find out more about CEI here and learn about our history here. You can see our team of experts here, and see some of our work here and here.
 
Events Intern:
Events interns assist with organizing policy-related events, including webinars, book forums, Capitol Hill briefings, and our celebrated Julian L. Simon Memorial Award Dinner. This hands-on role involves helping with event registration and logistics, designing promotional materials, and conducting topic, venue, and speaker research.
 
Qualifications:
Applicants must have a strong interest in policy and politics, capitalism and economics, and libertarian/conservative principles. Applicants must have strong research, writing, and organizational skills. Applicants must possess a professional demeanor and the ability to handle confidential and private information. Applicants should be able to work independently, effectively, and efficiently. A basic understanding of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook is a must.
 
CEI also seeks interns to work on policy/research, marketing - and from time to time, philanthropy/fundraising, government affairs, events, litigation, and IT. During the interview, we would be more than happy to discuss these other opportunities if they are available and of interest to you!
 
This role is in person, in Washington, D.C.

description:
Summary

 

Natera’s Pharma Discovery Lab (PDL) bridges R&D execution, analytics, and target and biomarker discovery and development.  We are seeking an Director/Associate Director of Portfolio & Program Management to build and run the operational backbone of PDL. The successful candidate will manage a broad portfolio of internal and external projects from inception to execution - managing portfolio metrics, tracking budgets, stage-gating project milestones, coordinating wet lab / dry lab / bioinformatics, RWD analytics resourcing, and managing pharma-partner engagements (biomarker consultation, translational research contracts, and target discovery/co-development projects) from intake through delivery. The role sits at the intersection of science, business, and operations, and reports into PDL leadership.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Internal Project Management - Cross-Functional & Operational Coordination:

-Work closely with lab and IT operations to build out PDL on time and on budget

-Serve as the operational lead for internal cross-functional projects across PDL and the BioPharma BU

-Track deliverables, timelines, and resourcing for PDL pharma contracts and flag risks to scope, budget, or timeline early

-Work with R&D and Commercial project management operations to ensure line of sight for PDL projects and ensure transparency between the organizations

-Coordinate shared infrastructure and CapEx planning between the pharma-facing PDL and the internal R& Lab to maximize ROI on shared equipment and space.

-Coordinate across wet lab (DNA/RNA/digital pathology, biorepository, spatial transcriptomics, single-cell RNA,advanced microscopy), dry lab/bioinformatics, and BD/pharma partnerships teams to keep PDL commitments on track.

-Support resourcing and hiring plans to close identified capability gaps in partnership with lab and discovery leadership.

-Facilitate recurring working groups, client status meetings, and internal review forums; author agendas, minutes, and action-item tracking.

 

Business & Financial Operations:

-Support go-to-market and monetization structuring for PDL offerings in partnership with BD and finance.

-Maintain program-level budget visibility, resource forecasts, and spend tracking against the approved investment case.

 

Communications & Stakeholder Management:

 

-Act as a trusted cross-functional partner to scientific, laboratory, BD, and commercial stakeholders, translating

scientific priorities into operational plans.

-Prepare client-facing materials, KOL engagement support, and scientific narratives supporting regulatory and

commercial adoption of PDL-enabled diagnostics.

-Manage change and communication strategies as PDL scales, including team structure, roles, and process updates as the portfolio grows.

 

Qualifications:

 

-10+ years of experience in oncology drug development, translational research, or biomarker/CDx program

management, ideally spanning both pharma and diagnostics/lab-services environments.

-Demonstrated track record leading complex, cross-functional programs - governance operations, portfolio/program

tracking, and stakeholder management at the senior leadership level.

-Experience managing biomarker sample operations, biorepository/biobank workflows, or CDx-adjacent laboratory

operations.

• Financial acumen, including budget forecasting, resource planning, and experience supporting deal or contract

structuring (fee-for-service, milestone, royalty, or licensing models).

• Strong meeting facilitation, executive communication, and document-authoring skills; comfortable presenting to

senior leadership and external pharma partners.

• Ability to navigate ambiguity in a newly-formed business line and build process/governance from the ground up.

• Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, or MS) in a life sciences required; MBA or equivalent business training a plus.

description:
Hardware Design Team Lead

Bristol, UK

About the job

Lead the engineers behind the power, timing and control circuits that make Graphcore’s AI compute hardware work.

Your team’s schematics, component choices and electrical constraints will give PCB layout engineers complete inputs for implementing each design. You’ll help test and manufacturing teams understand expected behaviour, resolve circuit issues and take hardware through to production.

You’ll line-manage engineers, coach their development and agree achievable commitments, matching the work to available capacity. You’ll coordinate reviews and investigations, ensure corrective actions reach closure and plan ahead for tools, licences and compute resources.

Grow your leadership across the hardware lifecycle, drawing on specialist expertise rather than becoming the technical authority for every circuit. Build a more autonomous team whose methods and shared knowledge improve how Graphcore develops its next generation of hardware.

The team and culture

You’ll connect Hardware Design with SI/PI, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, systems and firmware engineers across locations. Programme management owns the integrated plan; you’ll flag competing priorities early and bring practical options for resolving them.

Technical owners help agree operating conditions, margins and acceptance criteria. You’ll encourage engineers to challenge assumptions, using evidence and specialist advice to resolve difficult trade-offs.

What we’re looking for

• People leadership that develops engineers, delegates effectively and addresses difficult performance issues, with readiness for formal line management.

• Experience coordinating engineering delivery with programme management, including estimates, work allocation, dependencies and capacity, with sound judgement under schedule pressure.

• Communication that builds relationships across disciplines and locations, resolves competing expectations and secures decisions by explaining risks and trade-offs.

• A strong hardware engineering background spanning circuit and schematic development, board implementation, verification and production transition. An engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Understanding of power supplies, sequencing, reset, clocks, digital interfaces and SI/PI constraints, with judgement about when specialist input is needed.

• Experience organising technical reviews, maintaining traceable design records and ensuring investigations and corrective actions reach a clear conclusion.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

title: Engineering Manager/Tech Lead Manager - Runtime Engineering
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ENGINEERING MANAGER - SPARK RUNTIME ENGINEERING

Location: Bellevue, WA or Menlo Park, CA

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Spark Runtime Engineering Team brings Snowflake’s performance, efficiency, and reliability to Spark workloads. Our mission is to help customers scale data processing while preserving the familiar Spark APIs and semantics they rely on. We build the compiler and runtime integration that translate Spark workloads into efficient execution on Snowflake’s cloud-native query engine. This includes tackling complex challenges in compiler infrastructure, query-plan lowering, Spark compatibility, execution integration, and end-to-end observability to deliver faster, more cost-efficient data processing at scale.

We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager who combines deep technical expertise with strong people leadership. You will shape the team’s technical direction, stay actively engaged in architecture and critical engineering decisions, and hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team to advance the future of Spark on Snowflake.

ROLE OVERVIEW

You will lead a team of approximately 5-8 engineers building production compiler and runtime capabilities for Spark workloads on Snowflake. You will guide architectural decisions, review critical designs and code, and help investigate complex correctness, performance, and reliability issues. In partnership with compiler, query engine, runtime, and product teams, you will turn customer needs into a focused roadmap and measurable engineering outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Set technical direction for Spark query compilation and runtime integration, including intermediate representations, type resolution, semantic compatibility, query-plan transformations, and efficient SQL generation.

- Improve end-to-end workload performance and cost-efficiency through profiling, compilation-latency reduction, metadata-access improvements, and collaboration with query-engine teams.

- Establish strong correctness and compatibility practices, including differential testing against Apache Spark, regression coverage, and clear handling of unsupported behavior.

- Own the production quality of the team’s components, including observability, incident response, fault recovery, and safe rollout practices.

- Hire, coach, and develop engineers; provide actionable feedback, manage performance, and support career growth across experience levels.

- Partner with senior technical leaders and Product Management to prioritize investments, manage dependencies, and deliver a realistic roadmap.

- Validate changes against representative customer workloads and track measurable improvements in compatibility, latency, reliability, and cost-efficiency.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years of direct engineering management experience, with demonstrated success developing engineers and delivering production systems.

- 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including substantial work on compilers, query-processing systems, or runtime infrastructure.

- Deep expertise in at least one relevant area, such as compiler architecture and IR transformations, relational query processing, language semantics and type systems, or runtime integration.

- Proficiency in Scala, Java, C++, or a comparable implementatio

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Principal Python Developer
Location: 100% Remote (United States)

Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Python Developer to design, build, and continuously enhance complex enterprise-grade applications, data-intensive services, and automation platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on delivering robust, secure, and high-performance Python systems that operate reliably within distributed and mission-critical production environments. The ideal candidate will bring deep Python expertise combined with strong fundamentals in software architecture, data engineering, and operational support, and will partner closely with product, data, and infrastructure teams to translate ambiguous business problems into well-engineered technical solutions. • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of applied Python development experience in enterprise-grade environments.

• Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in dynamic, fast-changing environments while keeping stakeholders well informed.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating with both technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong shell scripting skills in UNIX/Linux environments and comfort working with command-line tooling.

• Solid grounding in mathematical and statistical concepts and the ability to translate them into code.

• Hands-on experience with the Python data and ML ecosystem, including NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.

• Working exposure to AWS cloud services and cloud-native storage technologies such as S3, RDS, DynamoDB, and Glue.

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. title: Engineering Intern (London, Summer 2027)
description:
ABOUT HIYA

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The engineering intern position is for an individual contributor who is responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining significant systems that serve hundreds of millions of requests per month. Hiya provides high-availability, latency-sensitive capabilities to telecoms, mobile apps, and other partners. In addition, you'll work with engineering teams across Hiya, some in Seattle and some in Europe, to define and deliver shared components and services. From day one, you will be paired with a dedicated mentor who provides structured guidance, technical feedback, and ongoing career mentorship.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design, code, and operate high-performance services and data processing pipelines on a modern technology stack, supported by a structured technical crash course during your first two weeks covering our core tools, architecture, and repositories.

Work at a supportive and fast-growing startup with a fantastic team, where you can collaborate with and learn from other great team members.

Make an impact in the lives of hundreds of millions of consumers.

Be supported in developing your skills and accelerating your career.

- Engineering: CS majors - 2nd year (graduating 2028)

- Excitement to work on innovative technology advancements

- A philosophy of iteration and continuous improvement

- Working knowledge of building services that adhere to operational SLAs

- A preference for velocity over perfection

- A commitment to respectful and impactful collaboration

- Self-motivated and excited to learn about new technologies

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS: THE HIYA VOICE AI CHALLENGE

Once we’ve confirmed your eligibility, you’ll receive the Hiya Voice AI Challenge by email-- a chance to build a working prototype of a voice-driven product in one of five tracks: Accessibility, Productivity, Creative Voice, Security, or Real-Time Assistance. You’ll have one week to build it, with optional virtual office hours along the way if you’d like to pitch your idea and get steering from our team first.

From there:

- Submit and get reviewed. One of our engineers reviews your work. If we’d like to explore your project further, you’ll get a link to book a 30-minute virtual session with an engineer or two-- a quick demo, a walkthrough of your code, and some questions.

- Final interviews, in person at Hiya. Candidates who advance join us for a final round in London (2nd & 3rd of December): a debugging/fixing session, a chance to add a feature to your own project, and a conversation about Hiya’s values.

AI tools are welcome and encouraged the whole way through.

- Dedicated technical mentorship with structured, regular feedback check-ins

- Clear project scope and goals provided right at the start of your internship

- Comprehensive onboarding to get you up to speed on Hiya's tooling, codebases, and systems quickly

- A supportive, collaborative environment built on psychological safety and genuine impact

At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. title: Customer Activation Manager | Stack Accounting
salary: $121K – $184K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission • Multiple Ranges
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is hiring Customer Activation Manager for Stack, Ramp's purpose-built AI accounting platform https://ramp.com/stack for accounting firms and in-house finance teams. Its agents follow each team's processes across connected systems to complete reviewable accounting work, from recurring tasks through close and reconciliations. You will help customers identify use cases, translate their accounting process into a practical implementation plan, and build trust in agentic bookkeeping through results, impact, and deployment. You will own the customer-facing path from discovery through adoption, partner with specialists on technical setup, and help shape the playbook as the product grows. This role calls for accounting judgment, experience bringing software or process change to life with customers, and an understanding of agentic workflows.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Learn how each customer handles close, reconciliations, journal entries, exceptions, and review today; identify where Stack and agentic workflows can deliver useful value.

- Translate the current process into an implementation plan with clear inputs, owners, dependencies, validation steps, and human review.

- Guide Controllers, accountants, and other stakeholders from discovery through first use, training, and repeat adoption; adjust the plan when confidence or usage stalls.

- Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and other Ramp teams on deployments as well as process, systems, and product improvements

- Act as an advocate and expert on AI-assisted accounting work

- Turn early customer learnings into reusable discovery questions, launch steps, and adoption practices for the next implementation.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- Roughly 4+ years of relevant experience in customer success, software implementation, accounting systems implementation, finance transformation, consulting, or a related customer-facing role; level is flexible based on experience.

- Hands-on accounting fluency: you can explain source data, close or reconciliation steps, exceptions, controls, and sign-off with concrete examples.

- Experience translating an accounting or finance workflow into a software implementation or process change, with evidence of what improved.

- Ownership of customer or client adoption beyond setup, including stakeholder alignment, training, troubleshooting, and follow-through.

- Clear communication with both finance leaders and hands-on accountants, especially when a proposed automation needs validation or a change in scope.

- Comfort creating a plan and reusable process when the product and implementation motion are still evolving.

NICE TO HAVES

- CPA, public accounting, controllership, or accounting advisory experience paired with software implementation or consulting.

- Experience with accounting automation, close management, or forward-deployed accounting work.

- Familiarity with ERP or accounting-system integrations and the data or permission issues that arise during implementation.

- Experience helping accounting teams adopt AI-assist

Job Summary
The Sr. Manager, FP&A Global Process leads Agency-wide planning process management, owning the design, delivery, communication and continuous improvement of the agency’s budget and forecast processes, tools, and reporting standards. Serves as the primary partner for FP&A process governance - maintaining a strong understanding of agency strategy, organizational design, and finance policies and procedures to manage their impact on FP&A processes and partner divisions. Represents global FP&A budget and forecast requirements to the EPM Systems team, and partners with the Director of FP&A, CFO, and executive leadership on scenario planning, target setting, and resource allocation.

Budget & Forecast Process Ownership

• Own the global budget and forecast calendar, guidance, training, templates, and communications.

• Lead ongoing budget and forecast process optimization and coordination, including planning cycle simplification and Amended Budget optimization.

• Coordinate with the FP&A Reporting Sr. Analyst to establish appropriate reporting cycles and deliver budget and forecast packages and presentations.

• Collaborate with the Finance teams to analyze and consolidate insights into results, forecasts, and budget packages for review and presentation to the Director of FP&A, CFO, and executive leadership.

• Support the Director of FP&A in maintaining scenario planning models and provide input to target setting and resource allocation.

Team & Workforce Planning Oversight

• Oversee staff to execute continuous evaluation and improvement in the workforce planning process, redesign, and user experience.

• Drive best in class analyses in workforce planning, integrating trending and pacing, including Merit and Fringe budget development and reporting in partnership with GPR/HR, as well as headcount budget reporting.

• Supervise staff partnering with assigned divisions related to financial support.

FP&A Systems & Reporting Governance

• Maintain understanding of the agency’s metadata, systems (e.g., ePBCS, ERP, EPM, etc), and corresponding reporting tools and platforms.

• Represent global FP&A budget and forecast user and process requirements to the FP&A Systems team.

• As directed by the EPM Systems team, oversee FP&A team delivery of user support and Oracle release and roadmap activities, including functional user testing of the Workforce, Projects, and Amended Budget modules.

• Contribute to the design, testing, and implementation of new FP&A report requirements, partnering with the Manager, Reporting FP&A and Finance Systems team on EPM/ERP and BI reporting requirements and delivery.

• Establish stakeholder guidance and protocols for current and future FP&A reporting tools and reports to drive efficiency and consistency across the agency.

• Contribute to ongoing systems evaluation and enhancements, including testing of systems changes and analyzing data flows for process improvement opportunities.

Continuous Improvement & Training

Strategic Support
